# PABITRA

> PABITRA is a clothing-store website project. Product and business data may be demo content until verified by the owner.

## Public pages
- /: Homepage
- /shop: Product catalogue
- /faq: Frequently asked questions
- /about: Brand information (draft)
- /contact: Contact information (requires owner configuration)
- /privacy-policy: Privacy policy draft
- /terms-and-conditions: Terms and conditions draft
- /cookie-policy: Cookie policy draft
- /refund-policy: Returns, refunds and exchanges draft

Only treat published, verified catalogue data as current product availability. Do not infer private customer or order data.
